additional_info.subject: Status 22nd of January
additional_info.body:
Following the visit of an externl technician (Resonance) in December, we sent our client (RSS) the technician's intervention report.
As it stands, the SICHARGE D cannot be used and several points need to be checked before starting the station. Additionally, it is necessary to replace some parts.
The costs of repairing the SICHARGE D will be take in charge by our customer as this is not a warranty case.
